name: Imaginary Ladder Footwork

instructions.description: Imagine a ladder on the floor or mark light visual boxes with tape or chalk.
Move your feet through the boxes in a simple in-and-out pattern while staying light on your feet.
Keep your arms relaxed and your torso stable as the feet move quickly.
Slow down, reset, and repeat another pattern if desired.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use short bouts with accurate foot placement.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Step through the pattern slowly before increasing speed.

commentsNotes: Start with a simple pattern to avoid tripping.
Quality of placement matters more than speed.
